attempt.executor_was_committed_note: The executor was written, run once as a dry run, and deleted when the attempt aborted. It is not part of the repository and is not proposed here.
attempt.abort_stage_detail: The run passed TD01, TD15, TD09, TD02, TD03, TD16 and TD12, then failed while building the candidate set from the distinct stored probabilities.
attempt.abort_mechanism_note: The executor raised ValueError from float() rather than reaching a fail-closed branch, because no control anticipated a non-numeric token in this column. The operator classified the terminated run as ABORT_THRESHOLD_DERIVATION. Recording the mechanism honestly matters: this was a crash that behaved like a fail-closed abort, not a control firing as designed.
attempt.raised_exception: ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'np.float64(0.513922437119)'

defect_found.scope: every row of the column, all three model families
defect_found.numeric_content_damaged_evidence: Every inspected token matched an anchored wrapper pattern with a well-formed finite decimal inside, and every parsed inner value satisfied float(str(v)) == v.

counters.counters_note: Reported from the traceback and the executed source, not estimated. Where the evidence cannot prove an exact number it is recorded as UNKNOWN_NOT_ZERO rather than guessed, and never as 0.

aborted_derivation_run.csv_rows_read_into_memory_basis: csv.DictReader materialised every row before the model filter was applied
aborted_derivation_run.observed_target_values_classified_basis: the TD12 block completed; it precedes the failing statement
aborted_derivation_run.evaluable_rows_determined_basis: the count was computed in memory but the process terminated before emitting it; it is provably at least 1 because the executor aborts on an empty evaluable set and did not take that branch
aborted_derivation_run.probability_token_float_conversion_attem: sorted(key=float) raised on its first key invocation

subsequent_diagnostic_reads.diagnostic_note: These reads happened AFTER the abort, to characterise the defect for this record. They are reported because a counter must never be falsely zero. No F2 and no threshold resulted from them.

why_the_run_was_not_forced_through: Stripping the wrapper would have required a parse step no merged contract defines. TD07 forbids transforming values before selection, and the candidate set is contracted as the values present in the column. Inventing a parse rule mid-run would have made the resulting threshold an artefact of an unpinned implementation choice — the exact failure this contract chain exists to prevent. The rule is therefore locked prospectively, in this package, before any value is parsed for scientific use.
